items.statement: The submission uses the supplied LS first-coordination-sphere model and reports charge, multiplicity, geometry provenance and a reproducible excited-state protocol.
items.expected: 65-atom Table S6 geometry is used or explicitly transformed; charge/multiplicity and protocol are stated with validation evidence.

items.statement: The investigation covers the fluorescence-relevant visible window and validates assignments with state/orbital evidence.
items.expected: Coverage includes 350–700 nm (or a justified narrower attempted range), convergence/coverage evidence is supplied, and assignments are tied to orbital/NTO or equivalent evidence.

items.statement: A salient LS band near 400 nm is assigned primarily to Fe(II) to ligand π* MLCT character.
items.expected: The report identifies an approximately 400–410 nm salient band and supports predominantly MLCT character.

items.statement: A weaker LS band at approximately 545–550 nm has Fe(II) d–d character with partial MLCT character.
items.expected: The report identifies and assigns the approximately 545 nm feature as Fe d–d with partial MLCT character.

items.statement: A weak LLCT transition near 620 nm is reported for compound 1.
items.expected: The report identifies a weak approximately 620 nm ligand-to-ligand transition and reports its oscillator strength if resolved.
